narration.text: You've covered the essentials of how pay works at Brunswick: the Total Rewards picture and where base pay fits within it, the three principles behind every pay decision, how pay ranges are built from real market data, and the legitimate factors that shape individual pay within a range. Pay at Brunswick isn't arbitrary. It's a system — built on market data, internal fairness, and performance, and supported by reputable tools and a consistent process to ensure fair pay practices. If you have questions specific to your situation, your manager and HR Business Partner are your best resources. Thank you for completing this training.
